worldcombat.skill.flameburst.summary: Fires a flame ball on a shallow arc: where it bursts, the main target takes the burst while every other foe around the blast each takes a separate splash. No solid hit means no splash, and the fire only falls on those beside the target.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.description: Once the burst hits and deals damage, the main target takes about %1$s special damage and every other foe around the blast each takes a separate splash hit of about %2$s.
Splash is measured from the blast point with a radius of %1$s blocks; each other foe inside it is hit once.
Range %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, %3$s block body radius.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.spread.on: Spreading form: the fire reaches farther and heavier with more droplets, at lower burst power and a shorter throw.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.spread.off: Direct form: a heavier burst thrown farther, at a smaller and weaker splash.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.description: You may throw the ball toward any direction or point without first picking an enemy; a ball that strikes a block or any non-living body only scatters a small spray of fire on the surface, with no burst ring and no splash, and only a hit on a hostile living body spills the fire onto the other foes around the blast.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.growth.0: From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s and the splash to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.growth.1: From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s and the splash radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.use.0: Mid-range shot that also scorches those beside the target
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.use.1: Shave down a small cluster of foes at once
worldcombat.skill.flameburst.use.2: Finish foes beside the main target with the splash
On: 135% splash radius, 115% splash power and more, farther droplets, at 92% burst power and -1.5 blocks range. Off (direct): 108% burst power and +1.5 blocks range, at 75% splash radius and 85% splash power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from farther away.
On: with another foe beside the target, fire first so the flame spills onto more of them. Off: rank it as an ordinary ranged move.
On: low-health targets rank first, finished by the burst. Off: rank it as an ordinary ranged attack.
